Supabase Auth data residency for a Canada-Central project could not be verified: supabase.com is blocked by this environment's egress proxy. ADR-0015 requires personal data to stay in Canada, and identity data is personal data.
blockers.owner: Founder (or any network with access to Supabase docs)
blockers.effect: The authentication decision (Supabase Auth) is RECORDED but NOT RATIFIED. No auth implementation may start until this clears.
blockers.resolution: Founder attestation: project provisioned in Canada (Central), AWS ca-central-1; Supabase Auth records live in the project's own Postgres auth schema, so Auth residency follows the project database. Recorded in docs/governance/COMPLIANCE_REGISTER.md and AUTH_DECISION_GATE.md §6.
blockers.provenance: Founder attestation, NOT verified by this agent — supabase.com is blocked by the egress proxy. Recorded as an attestation, never as a measurement.
blockers.residual: Region confirmed from the connection endpoint hostname (ca-central-1) on 2026-09-03; a live query from the project remains outstanding (network).
blockers.does_not_resolve: The WorkBC/public-sector legal question on subprocessors, cross-border processing and contractual requirements. L-1 and L-3 remain OPEN. Product 3 must not be deployed to a public-sector customer on the strength of this.

blockers.issue: The Supabase staging project is not reachable from the Claude build environment. DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL are present and correctly shaped (verified without reading values). Direct TCP to aws-0-ca-central-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432/6543 times out; the egress proxy accepts CONNECT to those ports but relays no bytes (PostgreSQL SSLRequest gets no reply, startup gets ECONNRESET) and its README lists raw-TCP databases as unsupported; HTTPS to <ref>.supabase.co, supabase.com and api.supabase.com is policy-denied (403). Reported, not worked around.
needed: TCP egress from the build environment to aws-0-ca-central-1.pooler.supabase.com on 5432 and 6543, OR
the two connection strings as GitHub Actions secrets (SUPABASE_STAGING_DATABASE_URL, SUPABASE_STAGING_DIRECT_URL) so CI can run the migration deploy and the tenancy suites against staging, OR
the commands in docs/programme/STAGE01_EVIDENCE.md §8 run from any network that can reach the pooler, with the redacted output pasted into the PR
for Supabase Auth: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY or SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET, plus HTTPS egress to the project host
blockers.effect: Blocks the four NOT VERIFIED / BLOCKED items of the Stage 01 exit gate. Blocks nothing else: all engineering that does not need the live project is done and proven locally and in CI.
blockers.note: SUPABASE_REGION and SUPABASE_PROJECT_NAME, listed in the brief, are not set in this environment; nothing depends on them.

invariants_never_to_break: No autonomous application submission (ADR-0016). Stage 22 is blocked by design.
No sensitive demographic attribute may reach matching, scoring, ranking or recommendation (ADR-0007).
No unlawful data acquisition: no CAPTCHA bypass, access-control circumvention or fingerprint evasion (ADR-0008).
Never run npm audit fix --force: it leaves Payload's peer range (ADR-0017).
Never skip, disable or delete a test to obtain a green run.
No integration described above its recorded status in INTEGRATION_REGISTER.md.

RLS: set tenancy with set_config(name, value, true) inside the query's transaction; FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on every policied table; never guard on IS NULL alone — a recycled connection reports the empty string. Proven in tests/rls-isolation.test.ts, recorded as R-33.
Never print, log or commit DATABASE_URL / DIRECT_URL; diagnostics use describeDatabaseUrl() only.
Every new table is classified in src/lib/tenancy/rls-tables.ts and the RLS migration regenerated; the coverage test enforces it.
User-facing queries run inside requireTenant().run(tx => …); a db. call inside a run callback escapes the transaction and is a defect.
prisma migrate deploy is the only production migration path; db push is local prototyping only.
